entries.mem0ai/mem0: A universal memory layer and official Hermes Agent provider available as a managed cloud or self-hosted OSS. It features multi-level state management for users and sessions using hybrid retrieval and time-aware matching.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory engine featuring a custom vector graph engine with sub-300ms recall. It manages persistent user profiles and handles temporal changes and contradictions with native connectors for Notion, GitHub, and Google Drive.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent context database that uses a tiered L0/L1/L2 loading system and viking:// URIs. It significantly reduces token usage and improves task completion through filesystem-based organization and visualized retrieval trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agent that synthesizes cited answers with explicit gap analysis. It utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges to provide scoped institutional memory for teams.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A learning-focused memory system that implements retain, recall, and reflect workflows for long-term knowledge. It integrates as an LLM wrapper supporting providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Ollama.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A reasoning-first memory library that extracts conclusions from events and conversations. It uses peer-centric modeling and hybrid BM25/vector search to build stateful agents.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent provider that treats memory as a git repository, using branches and commits for context management. It offers 5-tier retrieval with sub-100ms latency and an interactive REPL with 24 built-in tools.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that generates persistent playbooks and artifacts to help agents solve complex tasks. It integrates via MCP and CLI and supports both local Pi runtimes and major LLM APIs.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system utilizing SQLite for sub-millisecond retrieval latency. It features a temporal knowledge graph and episodic compression, with native MCP support for Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a hierarchical summary DAG for depth-aware compaction. It preserves raw message lineage in SQLite and provides tools for grepping and expanding compacted context.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for the Honcho library that enables private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers and OpenAI-compatible providers via a Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis setup.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems using an open YAML engram format to eliminate API costs. It employs ACT-R activation to strengthen relevant facts and decay stale information.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first identity and secrets layer that provides portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and MCP clients. It uses SQLite storage and includes a repairable system for editing or reclassifying agent context.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It combines BM25, vector search, and knowledge graphs via MCP server and agent plugins.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: A context optimization tool that increases prefill speed by 1.5–3× through prefix cache reuse. It reduces prompt token usage by roughly 36% and provides native plugins for Hermes Agent and OpenClaw.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: An embedded, self-maintaining memory plugin that provides explainable recall via why_retrieved tags. It tracks contradictions and canonicalizes duplicates without requiring a separate server or GPU.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that consolidates temporal continuity, graph truth, and corpus retrieval. It leverages a multi-layered storage approach using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to reduce prompt noise.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system combining BM25 full-text search with ranked graph traversal. It automatically indexes local directories, URLs, and multimedia files using edge tags for navigable relationships.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses local-first storage with SQLite-vec and GGUF models via an MCP-native server.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A utility that reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking for tool selection. It includes a dashboard to track schema token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin using a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database with importance-weighted recall. It prioritizes high-priority memories during prefetch and supports GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that ensures real deletion of data to prevent persistent summaries from haunting recall. It includes a trace.jsonl audit log for monitoring every memory operation.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A plugin that integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory. It provides tools for manual storage and searching, alongside configurable query expansion and result reranking.

entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system for macOS and Windows that integrates with coding agents via an MCP server. It provides Hermes Agent access to over 100 skills, 150 design systems, and 261 plugins.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A library of 754 structured cybersecurity skills mapped to major frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. It follows the agentskills.io standard for discovery across 26+ AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: Enables the generation of draw.io diagrams from natural language, supporting presets like ERD, UML, and Flowcharts. It can visualize codebase structures for Python, JS-TS, Go, and Rust using thousands of official shapes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: An agentic evolver that automates skill deduplication and quality improvement through background evolution loops. It unifies skill libraries across teams and devices with native support for Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: An auditing tool that eliminates detectable AI writing patterns through rewrite, detect, and edit-in-place modes. It utilizes a two-pass detection system and 49 pattern categories to ensure human-like content.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform skills library based on industry guidelines and established books. It offers modular installation via npx or a plugin marketplace for Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically propose and generate reusable skills. It produces both Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation via dedicated slash commands.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI using progressive disclosure to reduce token usage. It supports both programmatic and filesystem-based Python skill definitions.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: A set of tools for extracting transcripts, captions, and timestamps from YouTube without using yt-dlp. It enables video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent and other compatible agents.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing and one-click installation of skills, featuring automated security scanning with 65+ threat detection rules. It includes a creator marketplace with crypto and Stripe payment protocols.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own analytical prompts using dynamic custom lenses via /prism-scan. It includes seven validated prisms for simulation and optimization, with /prism-reflect to identify analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A set of workflow skills that transform rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It offers Lite and Full modes and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A local-first Rust binary that manages long-running agents through structured memory and a plan-approve-execute cycle. It uses a durable card model for tracking tasks and evidence-backed QA gates for verification.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: A literate programming skill that weaves prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable code and automatically syncs edits back to the documentation.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: A memory system that captures high-value decisions via markdown files for cross-instance sharing. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on captured work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Provides agentskills.io-compliant tools for interacting with the Chainlink oracle network, including CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. These skills are installable via the Vercel skills CLI.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It ensures provenance through pinned commits and file:line citations while providing lifecycle tooling for versioning.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: The official FLUX image generation skills providing standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2. It includes API integration patterns for webhooks and support for precise hex color specifications.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry of reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification featuring a Python client and CLI. It supports versioned installation with recursive dependency resolution and Stripe/TON payment rails.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Facilitates the autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that uses three-layer lazy loading to minimize token consumption. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports hot-reloading of configurations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: Integrates Hermes Agent with Nextcloud to manage files, notes, calendars, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It uses HTTPS and App Passwords for secure communication.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# / .NET implementation of the agentskills.io specification with MCP integration. It leverages Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like Discord and Telegram based on model reasoning capabilities. It tracks token savings and quality scores in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: An adversarial code review tool that uses three parallel subagents to hunt for bugs and exploitability. It integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec for deterministic pre-scanning and uses an MCP server for false-positive suppression.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent swarm that simplifies code by targeting hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It uses a risk-tiered triage system to safely modify code and detect language-specific anti-patterns.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: An intelligent retrieval system for Hermes Agent that uses a five-layer approach, including FTS5 and dense embeddings. It filters large skill libraries down to the five most relevant options to reduce token usage.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: Automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC via protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: A collection of Nix packages that enables instant execution of Hermes and other AI coding agents via nix run commands. It ensures tools stay current through daily automatic updates.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: Provides scripts and configuration guides for running agent CLIs, including Hermes, on Android smartphones. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to grant the agent access to mobile hardware and UI.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install Windows desktop distribution featuring a GUI and 100 built-in tools. It supports local models via LM Studio and includes a dynamic tool maker for custom automation pipelines.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: A Termux-based deployment guide featuring a one-line installation script for rapid Android setup. It supports persistent memory and compatibility with over 200 AI models, including local Ollama instances.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: A community Helm chart for Kubernetes deployments that implements cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer safety for persistent storage and supports both direct deployment and CRD-based workflows.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: A security-focused deployment that sandboxes the agent with hardware-enforced kernel-level blocking of dangerous syscalls and network egress. It offers dynamic security policies ranging from strict to permissive access.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: A streamlined Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for custom tag builds.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: A NixOS module and package for declarative, reproducible deployments. It integrates sops-nix for secure secrets handling and manages agent configurations as systemd services.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: A production-ready headless deployment that configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service on Ubuntu and Debian. It is designed for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: A Docker-first control plane that allows users to operate multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It provides hierarchy-aware task scheduling and inter-agent delegation across separate workspaces.
entries.ellickjohnson/portainer-stack-hermes: A Docker Compose stack designed for Portainer deployment that includes a ttyd web terminal for remote access. It utilizes GitHub Actions for automated image builds.

entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration stack that uses a zero-dependency SQLite backend to dispatch tasks and monitor spend. It provides multi-gateway support for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph, featuring an Aegis review system for quality control.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project offers a TUI and PWA dashboard to monitor diverse coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code, within isolated sandboxes. It enables parallel execution by leveraging git worktrees and multi-repo workspaces.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A tiered architecture template designed to scale from a single VPS agent to full specialist teams. It utilizes a task bus pattern for delegation and includes bundled skills for security auditing and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This control-room template uses a level-based architecture to transition from individual agents to automated, orchestrated workflows. It features a task bus for specialist handoffs and includes skills for VPS provisioning and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: An orchestration platform for building autonomous swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenRouter. It provides visual org charts, durable agent memory, and support for scheduled runs.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: A centralized mission control interface that uses a Kanban board to track autonomous task statuses and review queues. It allows users to live-stream agent reasoning and perform human-in-the-loop verification on all completed tasks.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents through a real-time Web UI. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols to manage tool handling and agent dialogue flows via a Kanban interface.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: A specialized pipeline for end-to-end software development featuring 17 distinct agents for roles like research, implementation, and infrastructure. The system enforces mandatory quality gates through dedicated reviewer and tester agents.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: A meta-optimization tool that uses automated outer-loop search to refine Hermes Agent harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TB2 benchmark evaluations to track performance frontiers through structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena where autonomous AI companies compete for GitHub stars. The platform orchestrates nine agents, including Hermes, and provides a real-time dashboard to visualize tasks and scoreboard metrics.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: A delegation tool that routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code using ACP-style workflows. It prevents parent context pollution through isolation and enforces safety via configurable timeouts and character limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: A local pre-indexed knowledge graph that provides symbol relationships and call graphs to reduce token usage and tool calls. It auto-syncs on every file change, optimizing how Hermes Agent navigates complex codebases.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A Rust-powered CLI tool with a native TUI for monitoring token usage and costs across 20+ AI coding agents. It features public leaderboards and 3D contribution graphs to track spending and efficiency.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: A local trace viewer used to inspect system prompts, tool schemas, and streaming API traffic. It allows developers to compare adjacent requests via structured diffs and export sessions as portable HTML files.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that orchestrates autonomous CTO loops for issue triage and deployment. It provides 23 specialized skills and integrates with Vercel, Supabase, and Sentry for full-stack operations.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A collection of community-driven CLI themes and skins for the Hermes terminal UI. It offers customizable colors and ASCII art, supporting partial configurations through inheritance from the default skin.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills directly into the Claude Code Channel. This version eliminates the need for OAuth or external processes and includes MLOps tools for RL training and vLLM inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP. It provides a human-visible UI for real-time supervision, featuring durable state with action undo and agent-specific bookmarks.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A TAW Agent framework that enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents with per-folder configurations. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents with project-local memories and tools.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: A preconfigured setup utilizing RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings. It includes 40+ specialized skills for finance and DevOps with automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: A rapid deployment stack that uses Docker to run Hermes Agent with LiteLLM, Ollama, and Qdrant. It bundles 29 community plugins to enable zero-cost local GPU inference and free model routing.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A deterministic static linter that scans agent configs and system prompts for failure modes using HERM v1.1 scoring. It integrates into CI/CD pipelines to provide fast, free scanning without requiring LLM calls.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A migration utility that transfers personas, memories, and skills from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent. It maps complex model configurations to Hermes YAML format and handles the transfer of system-level credentials.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that provides a unified interface for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI. It serves as an all-in-one hub for managing multiple AI agent CLIs across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork application that integrates various agent CLIs into a single interface. It distinguishes itself with built-in file read/write capabilities and the ability to automatically generate editable .pptx, .docx, and .xlsx files.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A lightweight web-based interface using Python and vanilla JavaScript that maintains full feature parity with the Hermes CLI. It features a three-panel layout for efficient workspace file browsing and inline previews.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed to simplify the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing multiple AI providers, local OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and a wide array of messaging gateways and toolsets.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A comprehensive web dashboard focused on session management and channel configuration for platforms like Telegram, Discord, and Slack. It utilizes SQLite for local session storage and offers multi-profile control for models and memory.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a PTY terminal and Monaco editor for deep development. It introduces Swarm Mode for role-based dispatch and includes an integrated MCP catalog and memory browser.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native macOS workspace that provides direct SSH connections to Hermes without the need for browser wrappers or daemons. It includes dedicated views for Kanban boards, cron jobs, and session data.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard featuring the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and Kanban pipelines. It offers a full MCP server control plane with log tailing and a browser-based terminal.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and 'agent cockpit' designed for indexing and searching AI agent histories. It prioritizes privacy with local-only indexing and provides live usage tracking without remote logging.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A macOS interface specifically optimized for Hermes Agent instances running on Orgo cloud computers and SSH hosts. It features one-click automated installation and integrated WebRTC voice mode via OpenAI Realtime.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, tailored for Chinese users. It includes a built-in kernel manager for health checks and supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for those preferring a terminal-based experience. It provides Kanban boards for diagnosing agentic work alongside TUI management for profiles and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed as a Telegram Mini App for managing Hermes on the go. It allows users to spawn background agents, manage cron jobs, and monitor system health via integrated gauges.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install Windows portable desktop that requires no admin rights or Docker. It bundles over 100 tools, including ComfyUI and MusicGen, and includes a dynamic tool maker for creating API wrappers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic, self-hosted web interface built with React 18. It provides real-time log streaming and an integrated file browser for managing workspace skills and MCP tools.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard that provides a real-time activity feed via WebSockets. It focuses on observability, offering read-only access to config files and FTS5 search for session histories.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first self-hosted workspace featuring tool approval cards and real-time SSE streaming. It includes a dedicated marketplace for discovering MCP servers and isolated profile management for separate API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and a PM orchestrator for managing complex tasks.
